before: A direct section break copied another person's pending section records onto its paragraph mark, and its revert left them there: they drew the section again, so the break stayed and kept that person's card on the mark, and a later reject drew the section with its page size only. A direct page setup, furniture option or section type made over another person's pending section record stayed when that record was rejected in the room, and went after a checkpoint.
after: A revert of a direct section break takes every other section record off its mark, and its redo copies the pending ones of the section it cuts again. A direct section write names the pending section records it was made over (over), as a direct paragraph or format change does, and their reject takes it away, as Word restores the record. A header or footer reference is in no section record and names none. The room and a checkpoint give the same Word file and the same cards.
reason: Change messages, the change log and its kinds keep their meaning, and the Yjs document format does not change. The new record field and the settle are read by every copy from the same change log with the same code version; an ordered room admits only clients of its own code version. A checkpoint holds no direct record, so its format does not change. Ordered rooms are not deployed yet, so no room needs a migration. Exported Word files do not change except where the room disagreed with Word.
